title: Dispute over marshals at Sunday's parade; Slow Drag and Pork Chop
summary: The club disliked marching behind the hired band's marshals; Wilson knows Slow Drag and Pork Chop, and a dancer named Rankin.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Well how come you had those two marshals in front, those two fellas in front this Sunday?
Well we, those are our two regular marshals.
No no I mean Fats Houston and Slowdrag, the big guy.

Oh I don't know that they, they brought those fellas there you see. But now that's what, that's what all the hump was. That was all the kick about. The club didn't want to march behind them. They didn't want to do the, put their own grand marshal there but this little fella there?
The fella that signed the contract? Yeah. Jaffe, you're on Jaffe.

Well he wanted this fella see. But see we should, see my marshal should have led the band, then my second marshal should have led the club. So that's the way we turned out. I have a number one marshal, he leads the procession. And my second grand marshal, he leads the members, the banner. But as he wanted like that, well we let him go head on like that. But we don't, we have, if we're gonna turn out, they didn't like the colors. They didn't like the colors. I told them what don't make any difference, well that we all, otherwise we're just filling in to help them fellas out and we're doing the job. We're not parading, we're not paying for nothing. See if we had to pay for that band then nobody else would never got that, no indeed. I told them what we ain't paying for nothing, we don't care. They paid you in other words. I told them they're paying us so let them have it. Of course I know slow drags all for years. Slow drags an old, old time. And in fact all them guys, it was poke chops and that gang, I know all them fellas. Poke chops used to be a member of my old club, he prayed with us once or twice. He was out of the parade, he don't stay on stage, he's gone. Now we have a fellow around Jim's, he's called him Rankin. He can run poke chop in dancing. And you think that guy will get out there and dance? Now he'll get rid of them barrooms and cut up and dance. Poke chop ain't got a chance with him. What do you eat now? Poke chop had him out in the French bars once or twice. And he don't like that. He just like to, like we all, he likes to drink. And we'll all be sitting here drinking, and he'll get up on the floor and dance himself down. Hey, I wish I had this talent, I wish I could dance like that, I'm telling you. And let's just throw it away. And then start, he was dancing Sunday with me. You know what I mean? He danced Sunday with me.
